==Description== <!--T:10-->

<!--T:2-->
Insert a view of a Part in a raytracing project.

==Usage== <!--T:11-->

<!--T:3-->
# Select object in the [[Tree_view|tree view]].
# Click on [[Image:Raytracing_InsertPart.svg|32px]] or choose {{KEY|Raytracing}}  →  {{KEY|[[Image:Raytracing_InsertPart.svg|32px]] Insert Part}} from the top menu.
# View of selected part will be inserted in the raytracing project.
# If more than one raytracing projects exist in the active document you will be prompted to choose on specific project.
